_signals.x_guidance: For x402 pay-per-request inference, POST to /x402/api/inference/v1/chat/completions without Authorization. Prefer accepts[].find(a => a.scheme === "upto") and use exact only as fallback. Sign the chosen payment requirement, include base64(JSON.stringify(paymentPayload)) in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, and resend the same body. Successful paid responses return HTTP 200, PAYMENT-RESPONSE, and an OpenAI-compatible completion body. When using @x402/evm with viem, pass a signer object with explicit address; do not rely on walletClient.address if undefined.
